readme.text:
DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI 的插件全家桶
日志查询 · 环境变量 · MCP 服务器 · Prompt · Profile · RSS · 全局搜索 · Codegraph 集成 · 终端面板 · 容器面板 · 插件脚手架

dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-all
一次装齐，重启 dsh web 生效 · 只想要其中几个 → 按需安装

[是什么](#是什么) · [包索引](#包索引) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [开发新插件](#开发新插件) · [文档地图](#文档地图) · [参与贡献](#参与贡献)

在一张卡片里完成 **Elasticsearch / OpenSearch** 的日志检索：多来源统一清单、直连查询、时间分布与按字段分组下钻； agent 侧注册 `loglens_*` **只读**工具（`loglens_sources` / `loglens_search` / `loglens_fields` / `loglens_facets` / `loglens_context`）。Docker 容器日志不另起一套：作为**采集来源**复用现成的 `docker_logs`。

- **统一查询面**：多个来源在同一张卡片里切换与检索；查询串按来源方言给出可点示例与占位提示
- **从结果继续下钻**：时间分布上点柱即缩放到该时间窗（可撤销）；字段分组榜回答「哪个服务在报错」，点榜上的值即成为筛选条件
- **两种消费者同源**：面板与 agent 工具走同一层归一化与参数夹取，`loglens_search` 的返回形状与面板所见一致
- **只读，且受围栏约束**：四条路由都在回环加固档下（除「开关」这一动作外都要同源证明）；出站按解析后的 IP 判定（链路本地 / 云元数据地址拒绝）、不跟随重定向、有体积与超时上限

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-loglens
```

完整用法、配置形状与契约 → [packages/loglens/README.md](packages/loglens/README.md)。

dsh-plugin-kit 是给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI 用的通用插件集合。所有插件都走官方 profile
机制挂载到 `dsh web`，**不改 DSH 源码**；可以逐个安装，也可以用聚合包一次装齐。

| 能力 | 原生 `dsh web` | dsh-plugin-kit |
|---|---|---|
| MCP 服务器 | 手改 patch / 命令行 | 可视化卡片 + 连接测试 + 保存后热加载 |
| 环境变量 | 手改 `env.yml` / 命令行 | Web GUI 卡片，保存即写入 `process.env` |
| Prompt 管理 | 手改配置 | 可视化编辑 + 版本管理 / A/B 测试 / 导出分享 |
| Profile 管理 | 命令行 | 可视化创建 / 复制 / 重命名 / 删除 |
| RSS 聚合 | 无 | 多源订阅 + 每日「今日值得读」+ 可选 AI 摘要（跟随宿主默认模型，零配置） |
| 全局搜索 | 仅会话标题 / 内容 | 侧边栏一处全文检索历史会话、Prompt、MCP 工具与设置面板 |
| 终端面板 | 无 | xterm.js 多标签真实 PTY + SSH 直连（连接簿 / 指纹钉扎 / 断线重连）+ SFTP 双栏直传；注册 `tty_*` / `sftp_*` 工具 |
| Docker 容器面板 | 无 | 容器 / 镜像 / Compose / 实时日志与统计 / 多目标总览；**默认只读**，变更与 exec 需显式开关；注册 `docker_*` 工具 |
| 日志查询 | 无 | **新**：Elasticsearch / OpenSearch 归一化成一个查询面（Docker 走现成 `docker_logs`；Loki 适配器在仓库里但**本版不在界面开放**）；面板里直接查 + 时间分布 + 分组榜；注册 `loglens_*` 工具（全 read 档） |
| Codegraph 集成 | 无 | 代码图谱卡片：索引状态 / 符号搜索 / 调用链 / 影响面 / 一键 sync-index |
| 插件开发 | 手写样板 | `pnpm create-plugin` 脚手架 + `@hyzyn/dsh-kit` 共享工具库 |
> **每个插件的完整功能、截图与注意事项在它自己的 README 里**（见下表）。本文件只讲「是什么 + 装哪个」。

**1 个共享库 + 11 个功能插件 + 1 个聚合包**；包之间的关系、依赖方向与跨插件协作见
[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)。

| 包 | 干什么 | 文档 |
|---|---|---|
| `@hyzyn/dsh-kit` | **库**（非插件）：宿主半体共享工具——HTTP 回环围栏、托管区块、`!!js` 表达式、服务读取 | [README](packages/kit/README.md) · [DEFECTS](packages/kit/DEFECTS.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-env` | 环境变量 / 密钥管理 | [README](packages/env/README.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-mcp` | MCP 服务器配置卡片，保存后热加载 | [README](packages/mcp/README.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-prompt` | systemPrompt 编辑 / 版本 / A/B | [README](packages/prompt/README.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-profile` | `~/.dsh/profiles` 图形化管理 | [README](packages/profile/README.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-kit-settings` | 在官方「设置」里补一行「插件配置」入口 | [README](packages/kit-settings/README.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-rss` | RSS 聚合 → 每日「今日值得读」 | [README](packages/rss/README.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-search` | 侧边栏全局搜索（⌘ / Ctrl + K） | [README](packages/search/README.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-codegraph` | 代码图谱卡片 + MCP 托管 + 采纳率测量 | [README](packages/codegraph/README.md) · [DEFECTS](packages/codegraph/DEFECTS.md) · [ROADMAP](packages/codegraph/ROADMAP.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-tty` | 终端面板：PTY / SSH / SFTP / 隧道 | [README](packages/tty/README.md) · [DEFECTS](packages/tty/DEFECTS.md) · [ROADMAP](packages/tty/ROADMAP.md) |
| `@hyzyn/dsh-docker` | Docker 容器面板（本机 / SSH），默认只读 | [README](packages/docker/README.md) · [DEFE

- 已安装 DeepSeek-Harness，`dsh web` 可正常启动。**当前适配十三档基线：DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`、`0.2.0-rc.1`、
  `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-alpha.1`、`0.2.1-alpha.2`、`0.2.1-alpha.5`、`0.2.1-rc.1`、`0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.3`、`0.2.1-rc.4`、`0.2.1-rc.5`、`0.2.2-alpha.3` 与 `0.2.2-rc.1`**；
  `0.1.6-alpha.2` 及更早不再支持（最新八档都是显式声明，但**不都是零差异**：`0.2.2-alpha.3` 移除了一个
  主题令牌，rss / search 的侧栏 hover 已随档适配；`0.2.1-alpha.5` 带着判定器、`engines.dsh`、凭据与
  macOS picker 的真实行为变化；其余六档对宿主零差异——本轮新增的 `0.2.2-rc.1` 逐文件比对
  只有 4 个客户端的版本串变了。逐条证据见
  [`scripts/check-dsh-peers.mjs`](./scripts/check-dsh-peers.mjs) 头部的 cohort 说明）。
- 兼容性由每个可安装插件在 `peerDependencies` 里声明的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 范围保证，DSH 在**安装前**
  与**启动时**各校验一次。被拦下长什么样、怎么临时放行 → [docs/troubleshooting.md § 兼容性校验](docs/troubleshooting.md#兼容性校验)。
- npm 安装无额外要求；从仓库源码安装需要 Node.js >= 22.19 与 pnpm 10（低于此版本 `pnpm install`
  会**直接失败**，不是警告——判据见 [docs/conventions.md § 环境下限](docs/conventions.md#环境下限声明--engine-strict-才真的会拦)）。
  宿主自己的 Node 下限由宿主声明：`0.2.2-alpha.3` 起要求 **Node >= 24.9**（CI 的挂载车道已切到 Node 24），
  但本仓的开发下限仍是 `22.19`——老 cohort 继续在 Node 22 上工作。
  npm 侧只会打 `EBADENGINE` 提示、不阻塞安装。

**推荐按需装**——下面一行一个包，只装你要的。从「配置三件」起步最省（`env` / `mcp` / `prompt`，
都不向模型注册工具）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-env          # 环境变量 / 密钥
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-mcp          # MCP 服务器
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-prompt       # systemPrompt
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-profile      # Profile 管理

包名、一句话说明与各自的文档见上方 [包索引](#包索引)。

**装之前知道一件事：各包动到的面不一样**（细节在各包 README；机制见
[docs/architecture.md § 7](docs/architecture.md#7-一条请求经过什么)）：

| 装了它 | 意味着 |
|---|---|
| **给模型注册工具**，真正改变 agent 能力 | `tty`（`tty_*` / `sftp_*`——真实的 shell / SFTP 通道）· `docker`（`docker_*`）· `loglens`（`loglens_*`，全部 **read** 档：只查你配置的日志后端）· `codegraph`（替宿主托管 codegraph MCP 行，于是 `mcp__codegraph__*` 进模型工具箱） |
| **只往 systemPrompt 添一段** | `rss`（「今日值得读」那段）· `search`（插件能力公告）；`prompt` 卡片做的本身就是编辑 systemPrompt |
| **只动你自己的配置与界面** | `env`（保存即写进宿主的 `process.env`，环境变量仍是你自己的配置）· `profile` · `kit-settings` · `mcp`（它是配置入口——自己不加工具，你填进去的服务器会） |

一次装齐就是聚合包，**权限敞口是各包的并集**——不知道要哪个就先别装它：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-all              # 聚合安装包
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit       # 仓库根 bundle（同样挂载全家桶）
```

装完**重启** `dsh web`，插件配置页里出现全部条目即生效；条目没出现多半就是没重启，
也可以用 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 确认插件配置层已挂载。
卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove @hyzyn/dsh-all`（或对应子包名），再重启。

> **配置入口在哪一版**：DSH ≥ `0.1.6-alpha.2` 有**两个**入口，指向同一份配置——侧边栏
> **「插件」**→ 选插件 → 该行的「配置」（官方新版两视图页面），以及**设置 →「插件配置」**
> （与「通用设置」平级的一行，由 `@hyzyn/dsh-kit-settings` 提供）。
> 客户端半体同时注册三代插槽（`plugins.row.config`、`settings.kit.item`、`settings.plugin.item`），
> 一份产物在各代上都能用。
> 这份配置本身落在**当前 profile 的插件 entry**（`cordis.patch.yml` 用户层），不再是全局 `settings.yaml`
> section，见 [术语表](docs/glossary.md)。

装不上 / 卡片不出现 / **插件整体消失** / 接口报 401、403 → [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md)。

readme.section: 从 GitHub 仓库安装（开发调试）
readme.text:
仓库根目录本身也是一个 DSH bundle（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch`，由 `pnpm aggregate` 生成）：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit.git
cd dsh-plugin-kit
pnpm install
pnpm build

> ⚠️ 如果 web profile 里已经装过 `@hyzyn/dsh-all` 或任一 `@hyzyn/dsh-<包名>`，
> 不要再 add 根包（或 `packages/all`），否则插件行重复挂载会在启动时报
> `duplicate loader entry id`。

> 只想用某个子包：最后一步改为 `dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/<name>`。

> 根包声明了 `dsh` 字段后，GitHub 的 DSH 插件市场会把本仓库识别为 DSH 插件（cordis-plugin）。

```sh
pnpm create-plugin <name> [id]

readme.section: 例：pnpm create-plugin pet-tracker pt → packages/pet-tracker（插件 id: pt）
readme.text:
```

脚本会复制 `templates/hello` 模板、替换包名与插件 id，并自动更新聚合包。然后编辑
`packages/<name>/src/index.ts`，构建后本地调试：
sh
pnpm --filter @hyzyn/dsh-<name> build
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/<name>
```

**新包要建哪些文档、多长、编号怎么起**，**插件包的解剖**（`dsh.bundle.patch` / `cordis.patch.yml` /
`src/index.ts` / `dsh.client`），以及**六条容易踩的硬规矩**（客户端半体的地址来源、逻辑抽模块、
点击委托作用域、样式变量名与取值等）
→ [docs/conventions.md § 客户端半体](docs/conventions.md#客户端半体六条硬规矩)。

- 新插件用脚手架生成：`pnpm create-plugin <name> [id]`，避免手写样板。
- 提 issue 走模板（**Bug 报告** / **功能请求**，空白 issue 已关闭）：必填的环境 / 版本 /

A plugin family for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI
Log query · Environment · MCP servers · Prompt · Profile · RSS · Global search · Codegraph · Terminal panel · Container panel · Scaffolding

dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-all
installs the whole family · restart dsh web to take effect · only want a few? → install on demand

[What it is](#what-it-is) · [Packages](#packages) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Writing a new plugin](#writing-a-new-plugin) · [Documentation map](#documentation-map) · [Contributing](#contributing)

Search **Elasticsearch / OpenSearch** logs without leaving the card: one shared source list, direct queries,
volume over time and drill-down by field. On the agent side it registers the `loglens_*` **read-only** tools
(`loglens_sources` / `loglens_search` / `loglens_fields` / `loglens_facets` / `loglens_context`).
Docker container logs need no second stack: they are a **collection source** reusing the existing `docker_logs`.

- **One query surface**: several sources are switched and searched inside the same card; the query string gets clickable examples and placeholders in each source's own dialect
- **Drill down from the result**: click a bar in the volume chart to zoom to that window (reversible); the group-by board answers "which service is erroring", and clicking a value turns it into a filter
- **Both consumers share one layer**: the panel and the agent tools go through the same normalization and clamping, so `loglens_search` returns the shape the panel shows
- **Read-only, and fenced**: all four routes sit behind the hardened loopback gate (every action but the on/off switch also needs the same-origin proof); egress is decided on the resolved IP (link-local / cloud-metadata addresses refused), never follows redirects, and is capped in size and time

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-loglens
```

Full usage, configuration shape and contracts → [packages/loglens/README.md](packages/loglens/README.md).

dsh-plugin-kit is a general-purpose plugin collection for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI.
Every plugin mounts through the official profile mechanism — **DSH itself is never patched** —
and you can install them one by one or all at once with the aggregate package.

| Capability | Plain `dsh web` | dsh-plugin-kit |
|---|---|---|
| MCP servers | edit the patch file / CLI | visual card + connection test + hot reload after saving |
| Environment variables | edit `env.yml` by hand / CLI | Web GUI card, written into `process.env` on save |
| Prompt management | hand-edited config | visual editing + versioning / A/B testing / export & share |
| Profile management | CLI | visual create / copy / rename / delete |
| RSS aggregation | none | multi-source subscriptions + a daily “Today’s Worth Reading” + optional AI summaries (follows the host’s default model, zero config) |
| Global search | session titles / content only | one full-text search in the sidebar over past sessions, Prompts, MCP tools and settings panels |
| Terminal panel | none | real xterm.js multi-tab PTY + native SSH (connection book / host-key pinning / auto reconnect) + SFTP dual-pane transfer; registers `tty_*` / `sftp_*` tools |
| Docker container panel | none | containers / images / Compose / live logs and stats / multi-target overview; **read-only by default**, mutations and exec behind explicit switches; registers `docker_*` tools |
| Log query | none | **New**: Elasticsearch / O

> **Each plugin’s full feature set, screenshots and caveats live in its own README** (table below).
> This file only covers *what it is* and *what to install*.

**1 shared library + 11 feature plugins + 1 aggregate package.** How they relate, their dependency
direction and how they cooperate: [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) (Chinese).

- DeepSeek-Harness installed and `dsh web` starts normally. **Thirteen DSH cohorts are currently
  supported: `0.1.7-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-alpha.1`, `0.2.1-alpha.2`,
  `0.2.1-alpha.5`, `0.2.1-rc.1`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.4`, `0.2.1-rc.5`,
  `0.2.2-alpha.3` and `0.2.2-rc.1`**; `0.1.6-alpha.2` and earlier are no longer
  supported (the newest eight cohorts are explicit declarations, but **not all are zero-difference**:
  `0.2.2-alpha.3` removed one theme token, and the rss / search sidebar hover was adapted with it;
  `0.2.1-alpha.5` carried real host behaviour changes in the evaluator, `engines.dsh`, credentials and
  the macOS picker; the other six are zero-difference — this round’s `0.2.2-rc.1` differs only in the
  version string of four client bundles. The per-item evidence is in the cohort notes at the top of
  [`scripts/check-dsh-peers.mjs`](./scripts/check-dsh-peers.mjs)).
- Compatibility is guaranteed by the `@deepseek-ai/dsh` range each installable plugin declares in
  `peerDependencies`, which DSH checks once **before install** and once **at startup**. What a
  rejection looks like and how to admit a combination temporarily →
  [docs/tro

**Installing only what you need is the recommended path** — one package per line below, install just
the ones you want. Starting with the three configuration cards (`env` / `mcp` / `prompt`, none of
which register tools) is the cheapest way in:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-env          # env vars / secrets
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-mcp          # MCP servers
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-prompt       # systemPrompt
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-profile      # profiles

Package names, one-line descriptions and per-package docs are in the [Packages](#packages) table above.

**One thing to know before you install: the packages differ in what they touch** (details are in each
package's README; the mechanism is in
[docs/architecture.md § 7](docs/architecture.md#7-一条请求经过什么)):

| Install it | What it means |
|---|---|
| **Registers tools — genuinely changes what the agent can do** | `tty` (`tty_*` / `sftp_*` — a real shell / SFTP channel) · `docker` (`docker_*`) · `loglens` (`loglens_*`, all **read** tier: it only queries the log backends you configured) · `codegraph` (it hosts the codegraph MCP row for you, so `mcp__codegraph__*` lands in the model's toolbox) |
| **Only appends a section to the systemPrompt** | `rss` (the “Today's Worth Reading” section) · `search` (its capability announcement); what `prompt` does *is* edit the systemPrompt |
| **Only touches your own configuration and UI** | `env` (saving writes into the host's `process.env` — still your own configuration) · `profile` · `kit-settings` · `mcp` (a configuration entry point — it adds no tools itself, but the servers you type into it will) |

Installing everything at once is the aggregate package — **its exposure is the union of each
package's** — if you don't know which plugin you need, don't start there:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-all              # aggregate package
dsh plugin --profile web add @hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit       # repo root bundle (mounts the whole family too)
```

**Restart `dsh web`** afterwards; all entries appearing on the plugin configuration page means it worked.
If a card does not appear, you probably forgot to restart. You can also use
`dsh --profile web --dump-config` to confirm the plugin configuration layer is mounted.
Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove @hyzyn/dsh-all` (or the matching subpackage), then restart.

> **Which configuration entry exists in which version**: DSH ≥ `0.1.6-alpha.2` has **two** entries
> pointing at the same configuration — the sidebar **“Plugins”** → pick a plugin → its row’s
> “Configure” (the official two-pane page), and **Settings → “Plugin configuration”** (a row next to
> “General settings”, provided by `@hyzyn/dsh-kit-settings`).
> Client halves register all three slot generations (`plugins.row.config`, `settings.kit.item`,
> `settings.plugin.item`), so one build works on every generation.
> This configuration itself lives in the **current profile's plugin entry** (`cordis.patch.yml` user
> layer), not in a global `settings.yaml` section — see the [glossary](docs/glossary.md).
Install failures / missing cards / **every plugin gone** / HTTP 401 or 403 → [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md) (Chinese).

readme.section: Install from the GitHub repository (development / debugging)
readme.text:
The repository root is itself a DSH bundle
(`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch`, generated by `pnpm aggregate`):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit.git
cd dsh-plugin-kit
pnpm install
pnpm build

readme.section: Install from the GitHub repository (development / debugging)
readme.text:
> ⚠️ If the web profile already has `@hyzyn/dsh-all` or any `@hyzyn/dsh-<pkg>` installed, do **not**
> add the root bundle (or `packages/all`) again — duplicate plugin rows cause a
> `duplicate loader entry id` error at startup. For one subpackage only, replace the add step with
> `dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/<name>`.
>
> With the `dsh` field on the root package, GitHub DSH marketplaces classify this repository as a DSH
> plugin (cordis-plugin) instead of flagging it as “non-plugin”.

```sh
pnpm create-plugin <name> [id]

readme.section: e.g. pnpm create-plugin pet-tracker pt → packages/pet-tracker (plugin id: pt)
readme.text:
```

The script copies the `templates/hello` template, substitutes the package name and plugin id, and
updates the aggregate package. Then edit `packages/<name>/src/index.ts` and build for local debugging:
sh
pnpm --filter @hyzyn/dsh-<name> build
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/<name>
```

- Generate new plugins with the scaffolding: `pnpm create-plugin <name> [id]`.
- File issues through the templates (**Bug report** / **Feature request**; blank issues are disabled):
  the required environment / version / reproduction steps / **self-check results** map to the general
  sequence in [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md#通用顺序) — only a complete report can
  be triaged in the first round. Format rules:
  [docs/conventions.md § Issue](docs/conventions.md#issue提-issue-的格式约束).
- Commits follow Conventional Commits (e.g. `fix(mcp): …`); user-visible changes should come with
  screenshots or verification evidence.
- Run the gates before committing: `pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm aggregate`.
- After adding or removing a plugin, re-run `pnpm aggregate` to regenerate the `packages/all` manifest.
- Full conventions: [docs/conventions.md](docs/conventions.md).
